propositions: Exact duplicate AC items do not make a plan unexecutable and must be removed from hard clarity rules, retaining only advisory coaching.
Unresolved sentinels in Approach/Scope/Testing/Acceptance Criteria are hard floor violations only when appearing as value assignments, not in removal assertions or code fences.
Nonempty parsed AC checkbox items remain a hard clarity floor; whitespace-only joined bodies fail, but legitimate blank-line-then-continuation items pass.
File-impact path/reason validation belongs to write-schema integrity, not plan clarity scoring.
[rebar:id] direct-edge checking applies only to prerequisite-created symbol claims, not ordinary provenance or downstream references.
Five categories of violations are reclassified: two retained as hard floor, three moved to advisory-only or subsystem-specific validation.
